{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); CREATE TABLE invoices(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(id), amount INTEGER, status TEXT); CREATE TABLE payments(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(id), amount INTEGER);", "requirements": "Return each customer id and name, total non-void invoice amount as billed, and total payment amount as paid. Include customers with no invoices or payments using 0. Keep different customer ids separate even if names match. Sort by customer id. Status void is excluded from billed only.", "rows": {"customers": [[1, "Ada"], [2, "Ben"], [3, "Cy"]], "invoices": [[1, 1, 100, "open"], [2, 2, 50, "void"]], "payments": [[1, 1, 40], [2, 2, 15]]}}
Write one SQLite SELECT in a SQL code block. No other statements.

message.content:
```sql
SELECT 
    c.id AS customer_id, 
    c.name, 
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status != 'void' THEN i.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS billed, 
    COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS paid
FROM 
    customers c
LEFT JOIN 
    invoices i ON c.id = i.customer_id
LEFT JOIN 
    payments p ON c.id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY 
    c.id, c.name
ORDER BY 
    c.id;
```
